📺 Breeders (2020–2023)

Breeders follows Paul and Ally, a married couple living in London who struggle to balance the challenges of raising two young children with their demanding careers, complicated family relationships, and everyday responsibilities. Although they deeply love their children, Luke and Ava, the pressures of parenthood often push them to their limits, leading to hilarious arguments, emotional breakdowns, and unexpected situations. As their children grow older, Paul and Ally face new challenges involving school, relationships, mental health, and the difficulties of keeping their marriage strong. With help from their eccentric parents, they discover that raising a family rarely goes according to plan. Starring Martin Freeman and Daisy Haggard, the series combines sharp British humor, heartfelt drama, and relatable family moments while exploring parenting, marriage, love, frustration, and the realities of modern family life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family • Dark Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Martin Freeman, Chris Addison & Simon Blackwell

📺 Seasons: 4

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Breeders is a British dark comedy television series created by Martin Freeman, Chris Addison and Simon Blackwell. The series follows two parents who struggle with parenthood and is partially based on Freeman's own experiences. Freeman plays one of the two leads in the series, along with Daisy Haggard, and is also an executive producer on the show along with Addison and Blackwell. The series premiered on March 2, 2020, on the American cable network FX, and on the British network Sky One on March 12, 2020. The second series premiered in March 2021, and the third series in May 2022. The fourth and final series, premiered in July 2023.
